title: An arch-map project: its spec documents, the env it reads, its generator, snapshots and checks
description: <projects dir>/<name>/project.json (the projects dir: env ARCH_MAP_PROJECTS). Document paths are relative to the project's spec folder <projects dir>/<name>/specs/; script, guard and baseline paths to <projects dir>/<name>/. Read by scripts/lib/projects.ts.

name.description: The project's folder name in the projects directory.

theme.description: The viewer's look for this project (dark when unset). The page's ?theme=light|dark, ?accent=, ?accent2=, ?bg=, ?step= (hex without #) override it.

colors.description: Overrides of the base's colors: bg (page), panel, panel2 (raised surface), fg (text), muted (secondary text), line (borders), accent (selection, buttons, links), accentStrong (accent under text), step (scenario steps).

fonts.description: Font family names (IBM Plex, Manrope and JetBrains Mono are bundled; others must be installed where the map is viewed).

documents.description: The whole checked set, in load order.

open.description: What the map opens with: a subset of documents.

idPrefixes.description: The first segment of this project's element ids (for the neutrality guard and reports; no core logic reads it).

env.description: The environment variables this project reads (in .env.local).

default.description: Used when the variable is not set; ${OTHER} expands another variable of the project.

mustHave.description: A path that must exist under the directory the variable names.

snapshots.description: Ways to refresh the committed inputs: kind → script.

roots.description: Env variables naming target checkouts whose git status must not change. The first is required; the rest are checked when they exist.

outputs.description: Files under the project's spec folder that two runs must write byte-identical.

withoutRunTime.description: Outputs compared without their generatedAt and durationMs.

guard.description: Folders the generator reads and must not change.

args.description: Default arguments, used when none are given on the command line.

needs.description: Env variables that must be set (after defaults).

index.description: <projects dir>/index.json: every project folder in switcher order, and the one the map opens (required when order is not empty).
